author: AEGIS Game Studios
AGSCogs
description: Announces qualifying public or invite-only AutoRoom voice sessions with opt-out role support, true role pings, blacklists, delays, and persistent random message rotation.
end_user_data_statement: Stores guild configuration and message rotation state only. User opt-out state is represented by a configured Discord role and is not stored separately by this cog.
install_msg: Thank you for installing AGSVoiceAnnounce. Configure it with `[p]agsvoiceannounce channel`, `[p]agsvoiceannounce pingrole`, and `[p]agsvoiceannounce optrole`.
short: Voice room announcement pings with opt-out support.
